# Audio: 00:00.000 => 00:32.183

Transcript
```
WEBVTT

00:00.110 --> 00:00.670
<v Speaker 1>Good day.

00:00.910 --> 00:02.270
<v Speaker 1>Welcome to Contoso.

00:02.590 --> 00:03.790
<v Speaker 1>My name is John Doe.

00:03.950 --> 00:05.150
<v Speaker 1>How can I help you today?

00:05.470 --> 00:06.350
<v Speaker 2>Yes, good day.

00:06.670 --> 00:08.190
<v Speaker 2>My name is Maria Smith.

00:08.590 --> 00:11.390
<v Speaker 2>I would like to inquire about my current point balance.

00:11.710 --> 00:12.590
<v Speaker 1>No problem.

00:12.910 --> 00:13.950
<v Speaker 1>I am happy to help.

00:14.270 --> 00:16.750
<v Speaker 1>I need your date of birth to confirm your identity.

00:17.150 --> 00:19.630
<v Speaker 2>It is April 19th, 1988.

00:20.030 --> 00:20.510
<v Speaker 1>Great.

00:20.830 --> 00:24.190
<v Speaker 1>Your current point balance is 599 points.

00:24.590 --> 00:26.190
<v Speaker 1>Do you need any more information?

00:26.510 --> 00:27.230
<v Speaker 2>No, thank you.

00:27.630 --> 00:28.350
<v Speaker 2>That was all.

00:28.750 --> 00:29.390
<v Speaker 2>Goodbye.

00:29.710 --> 00:31.950
<v Speaker 1>You're welcome, goodbye a Cantoso.
```

Summary.valueString: John Doe from Contoso greets caller Maria Smith, who asks to check her current loyalty point balance. John requests Maria’s date of birth for identity verification (April 19, 1988) and then provides her balance as 599 points. Maria confirms she needs nothing else and the call ends with goodbyes.
